newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Oct industrial price index falls 0.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Canada Oct industrial price index falls 0.5 pct.

text.p: Statistics Canada on Wednesday issued the following economic indicators for October.
INDUSTRIAL PRODUCT PRICE INDEX Month-on-Month Year-on-Year
INDUSTRIAL PRODUCT PRICE INDEX Month-on-Month Year-on-Year
The IPPI reflects the prices producers receive as goods leave their plants.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast that the overall index would rise 0.3 percent in October from September.
